name: Dungeon Blitz R
storyline: Years ago, a mysterious catastrophe shattered Elyria and chained its broken islands to the sky. From the small harbor town of Lanza, new heroes set sail into drifting dungeons, hunting lost treasures and the source of the darkness eating away at the world’s heart. In Dungeon Blitz: R, players dive into fast‑paced side‑scrolling combat, choose from distinct character classes, and team up in online co‑op to reclaim a nostalgic realm that has been rebuilt for the modern era.
summary:
Dungeon Blitz R is a fan-driven revival of the classic side-scrolling multiplayer action RPG Dungeon Blitz. Rebuilt from the ground up, the project aims to bring back the fast-paced combat, cooperative dungeon crawling, and nostalgic charm of the original experience—now with modern infrastructure and ongoing development.

Featuring real-time multiplayer gameplay, diverse character classes, and skill-based combat mechanics, Dungeon Blitz R focuses on preserving the spirit of the original while expanding it with new systems and improvements.

Currently in active development, the game is transitioning to a TypeScript-based architecture to support scalable multiplayer features and long-term sustainability. Early versions are available to supporters, with a full public release planned alongside the multiplayer launch.
